verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has no documented cloud region picker, but you can control where data lives in other ways. You can self-host the whole stack (MongoDB, API, front-end) on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose. Experiment analysis queries your own warehouse rather than ingesting events. The SDK keeps targeting attribute values in local memory and never sends them to GrowthBook. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for GrowthBook Cloud (e.g. EU/US hosting), explicit data-residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration.
